notes.title: Free content update available now!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34833252/bc99282a5b506a344cc10090af5a8cdc96de45cd.png
The first free content update for 3D Custom Lady Maker is available now!

New Customization Options

T-Shirt (Top)
An ordinary t-shirt. Is it hers or one of yours...?

Denim Shorts (Bottom)
Why so formal? Short shorts for the summer heat.

Gym Shirt (Top)
A tight-fitting gym top. For sporty types.

Gym Shorts (Bottom)
A tight-fitting pair of gym shorts. Easy to move in.

Kiss (Paint)
Now how did that get there? A flirty kiss-mark face decal.

Star (Paint)
A cheerful face decal.

System Updates

You can now customize the colors of the Heart Earring and Sunglasses accessories.
You can now apply up to three Paint items simultaneously.
The names of several items have been adjusted to be more natural.

That's all for now. Stay tuned for the Summer Style Pack DLC, coming very soon and launching with a limited-time 20% discount!

Happy 3D custom lady making!
